install_tell: Kubernetes/Helm via Terraform on GCP/AWS/Azure; ingress host arize-app.<org-domain>
misconfig_patterns: ARIZE_API_KEY or ARIZE_SPACE_KEY committed to source repos or environment files
Self-hosted ingress misconfigured without TLS — gRPC OTLP endpoint exposed plaintext
Overly permissive Kubernetes RBAC on arize namespace allows lateral movement to trace data
Single-endpoint mode exposes all services (UI, OTLP, Flight) at one hostname without path-level ACL

active_probe.false_positive_check: Requires TLS cert CN containing 'arize-app' — generic /v1 endpoint is not sufficient

deployment_tells: Kubernetes namespace 'arize' with services internalendpoints-app, arize-otlp, arize-flight
Helm chart deployment via Terraform in customer AWS/GCP/Azure environment
gRPC endpoints for OTLP trace ingestion and Arrow Flight for feature store queries
pivot_paths: ARIZE_API_KEY + ARIZE_SPACE_ID -> programmatic access to all model monitoring data, embeddings, production traces
Arrow Flight endpoint -> bulk export of embedding vectors and prediction logs
OTLP gRPC endpoint -> LLM span data including input/output tokens
Kubernetes misconfigured RBAC -> lateral movement to trace storage (PostgreSQL/S3)
